captures.description: Publisher manually checked the Debian host 10.0.0.46 as normal; captured Deluge P2P downloads, Chrome browsing, Jabber and normal mtr reverse-DNS queries. All host unicast traffic and related router traffic are included; broadcast/multicast and unrelated LAN hosts were removed. Publisher capinfos reports 1282 seconds and non-strict timestamp ordering. Large opt-in case; benign findings must be retained rather than tuned away.

benign_exposure.basis: Publisher README identifies one manually verified normal host and a continuous host capture; publisher capinfos independently reports a 1282-second observation interval. This is monitored-host time, not an assumption that the user was active for every instant.
assumptions: The publisher continuous-capture description is accepted; no independent sensor uptime log is available.
Broadcast/multicast are removed, so exposure applies only to observable unicast behaviours for the declared rules.
Idle gaps remain monitoring time, not inferred activity; this small dataset does not establish deployment calibration.
Capture timestamps are not strictly ordered; detector handling of out-of-order traffic can affect counts.
